gaps.sentence: The stairs ___ (reinforce) when part of the ceiling gave way.
gaps.hint: action in progress at a past moment
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive: was/were being + past participle, interrupted by a sudden past event.

gaps.sentence: The ancient scrolls are far too brittle ___ .
gaps.explanation: The scrolls receive the action: passive infinitive to be + unrolled.

gaps.sentence: Over two hundred bird species ___ (record) in the valley this spring.
gaps.explanation: 'This spring' is an open time frame, so present perfect passive: have been + recorded.

gaps.sentence: The rare print ___ (steal) from the locked cabinet — the lock wasn't forced.
gaps.explanation: Perfect modal passive: must have been + past participle for a confident past deduction.

gaps.sentence: By next June, the entire collection ___ (move) to the new wing.
gaps.explanation: Future perfect passive: will have been + past participle for something finished by 'next June'.

gaps.sentence: Nothing ___ about the incident until the inquiry began.
gaps.explanation: Nothing was known by anybody: past simple passive was + known.

gaps.sentence: Construction ___ (halt) after the discovery of Roman remains.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: was + halted. The halting authority is unnamed.
The results receive the action: 'will be announced'.
